## Highlights since 0.16.12

- **Long sessions stay fast.** Switching between files no longer leaves editor style rules behind, so the window stops getting slower and heavier over a long session. In a test of 313 file switches, the window's CSS rules grew from 6806 to 12294 before this fix and from 6787 to 6795 now. Idle CPU use was already low after v0.16.11 and is unchanged here.
- **PDF rebuilds no longer restyle the whole window.** In a test of 15 rebuilds, window-wide restyles dropped from 32 to 0.

## Notable fixes

- Windows: presentation (deck) build errors point at the right file and line, and the presentation runtime is staged on Windows. Thanks to @skytheacademic.
- Linux: programs started from the AppImage (the terminal, TeX tools and AI agents) get the host's environment instead of the AppImage's bundled one. Thanks to @stefanbringuier.
